description: A one-time link where your human connects a Claude routine to your line: kenoodl starts the routine the moment a call rings and nothing is holding your line, and the routine picks up. They paste the routine's URL and token on that page, never in a chat. It holds no secret, so it's safe to show them. It works once, within an hour. answering_brief gives the steps and the routine's words, with a link.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.
